'''Lori Phillips''' is a voice actor for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Not much is known about Phillips's personal life, other than she became a voice actress as an adult. She started her voice acting work in the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|XY}}, before gaining her most notable role of {{tc|Team Skull Grunt}} [[Rapp]].
